name: hcportal_getPlatformAdmins
description: Platform admins list for HC Admin Tools > Platform admins (E12.F7.S1): every live HC.PlatformAdmin row (removed = 0) with the hasher behind it and the four capability flags; IsSelf marks the caller so the portal can stop them removing themselves. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth; the caller must hold a live HC.PlatformAdmin row with CanManagePermissions = 1. HC.PlatformAdmin is the only platform-wide grant (AppAccessFlags 0x40000000 is the per-kennel Super Admin flag).

rowsets.name: Refusal
rowsets.description: { Success = 0, ErrorMessage } when auth or the CanManagePermissions gate fails. A runtime error inside the TRY is logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown (no envelope).

rowsets.name: PlatformAdmins
rowsets.description: One row per live platform admin, ordered by TRIM(HashName), LastName, FirstName.

columns.name: Email
columns.description: HC.Hasher.Email (NOT NULL; may be a generated address)

columns.name: HomeKennel
columns.description: Home kennel short name (LEFT JOIN; NULL when the hasher has no home kennel)

columns.name: CanEditKennel
columns.description: Edit any kennel, approve kennel requests, merge accounts

sideEffects: On a runtime error: INSERT HC.ErrorLog, then THROW
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
